text:
minji: Quick canary note: bringing up nova-v1@2026-03-10 with q8_kernel_opt; seeing ZWJ (U+200D) dropped in furigana/vertical detok causing BLEU regression.

raj: can you paste minimal repro + runtime flags?

minji: sample: 
```
PROMPT:  漢字‍カな  # Han + ZWJ + Kana for ruby
FLOAT32 OUT: 漢字‍カな
Q8 OUT:     漢字カな  # ZWJ missing
```

minji: quick eval: float BLEU=34.0, q8 BLEU=30.1 (delta -3.9). Token trace shows id=1 present pre-pack but absent after pack/unpack on q8 runtime.

kevin: suspect fast_pack_v2 introduced unicode_normalize or strip_zero_width. I'll bisect kernel commits.

triage-bot: Created INF-5577: "q8 pack path drops ZWJ in vertical detok" assigned kevin P2.

raj: mitigation: gate pack unicode normalization by locale (ja/zh/ko) or set strip_zero_width=false for CJK canaries. minji: can you open a short PR?

minji: opened PR to force preserve_zwj for CJK in canary config and uploaded per-sample diffs to INF-5577.

kevin: update: found commit 9f8d7e adding unicode_normalize in fast_pack_v2. Trying revert locally and running furigana suite.

kevin: if revert is safe we can ship; otherwise we'll add a flag pack_unicode_normalize and default false for CJK locales.

minji: thanks, ping here with bisect result.
